slides.title: Domain and SSL are set.
slides.body: Your own domain, and the padlock in the browser. No padlock, no trust.

slides.title: Tested on real phones.
slides.body: Open every page on an iPhone and an Android. Tap every button.

slides.title: Every form actually sends.
slides.body: Send a test message from each form and check it really arrives.

slides.title: Google can find it.
slides.body: Titles, descriptions and a sitemap submitted to Google Search Console.

slides.title: It loads fast.
slides.body: Compressed images and clean code. Check the speed on mobile data, not Wi-Fi.

slides.title: Analytics are on.
slides.body: Know how many people visit, where they come from and what they click.

slides.title: Backups are running.
slides.body: If something breaks, you should be one click away from yesterday's version.

slides.title: We check all seven for you.
slides.body: Every MBN DEV launch goes through this list.
